PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, OCTOBER 1, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Gloria Cordero, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Vice President  Kevin Scott, Commissioner
Al Austin II, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  Members of the public have the option to email comments to commission@lbutilities.org

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  26-56284  Recommendation to approve September 17, 2026 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-56285  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to amend Agreement No. UT-3964 with The Segal Group, Inc., for
  professional classification and compensation consultant services with an expanded
  scope of work to include individualized job description questionnaires and increase
  the contract amount by $25,000, for a revised contract amount not to exceed
  $100,000.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-56286  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to amend Agreement WD-3665 with Stanley Consultants, Inc., of
  Muscatine, Iowa, for the Well Asset Management Project, to extend the term of the
  contract through December 31, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-56287  Recommendation to adopt Specifications UD-26-338 and award a contract to SHI
  International Corp., of Somerset, New Jersey, for the purchase of Computer
  Hardware and Peripheral Supplies, in an annual amount not to exceed $500,000
  for the first one (1) year period, with the option to renew for four additional one-
  year periods, subject to a maximum annual increase of 5% for each renewal
  period, for a total contract amount not to exceed $2,762,816; and authorize the
  General Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter into the contract,

  Page 1 of 4
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, OCTOBER 1, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  including any amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

REGULAR AGENDA

5.  26-56288  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal No. UD-26-345 and award a
  contract to Water Resources Economics LLC, of Culver City, California, for a Cost
  of Service and Rate Study, in an amount not to exceed $122,953 for the first one
  (1) year period, with the option to renew for four additional one-year periods at the
  following rates: first renewal: not to exceed $30,000, second renewal: not to
  exceed $32,500, third renewal: not to exceed $35,000, and fourth renewal: not to
  exceed $37,500, for a total contract amount not to exceed $257,953; and authorize
  the General Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter into the
  contract, including any amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-56289  Recommendation to receive and file September 17, 2026 Communications
  Committee Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-56290  Recommendation to receive and file the General Manager’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

CLOSED SESSION

26-56291  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957(A), consultation with Shaun
  Curtis, Manager, Security and Emergency Preparedness, and Alvin Lam, Director of
  Information Services, to discuss and assess threats to public services or facilities.

26-56292  Pursuant to Paragraph (b)(1) of Section 54957 and Section 54957.6 of the California
  Government Code regarding Public Employee Performance Evaluation, Terms of
  Employment and Compensation: General Manager.

ADJOURNMENT

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 9:00 AM, President Cordero called the meeting to order.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Joy Contreras, Public Information Officer, Utilities Department, led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL

President Cordero welcomed the officers to their new roles and thanked outgoing President Scott for
his leadership and service. Commissioners expressed their appreciation for his contributions to
streamlining Board meetings and improving committee preparation. President Cordero also
emphasized the importance of public service and environmental sustainability.

President Cordero announced that the General Manager evaluation closed session item had been
withdrawn from the agenda and would be rescheduled for a future Board meeting.
